title: Counting Forward and Backward to 120
standard_text: 1.5A recite numbers forward and backward from any given number between 1 and 120
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 counting worksheets for Texas TEKS 1.5A: count forward and backward to 120, next and before, number words and 120 chart puzzles. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Forward is 1 more; backward is 1 less.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Count forward: each number is 1 more. Count backward: each number is 1 less.
  • After 59 comes 60: the ones go back to 0 and the tens go up.
  • After 100 comes 101, 102, … 120.
  • On a 120 chart, the number to the right is 1 more.

Examples

Example

98, 99, 100, ☐

1 more than 100

Answer: 101

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Missing the decade changeAfter 59 comes 60.
Writing 101 as 1001One hundred one is 101.
Counting the wrong wayBackward means 1 less each time.

faq.a: Recite numbers forward and backward from any given number between 1 and 120.
Move right for 1 more and down for 10 more.

items.q: How many apples are there?
items.e: Point and count each one: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8. There are 8 apples.
Each full row has 10. Count the rows by 10s: 10. There are 10 stars.

items.q: How many dots are there?
items.e: The first ten-frame is full. That is 10. Then count on: 11. There are 11 dots.

items.q: How many balls are there?
items.e: Each full row has 10. Count the rows by 10s: 10. Then count on by 1s: 11, 12, 13. There are 13 balls.
Each full row has 10. Count the rows by 10s: 10. Then count on by 1s: 11, 12, 13, 14, 15. There are 15 buttons.

items.q: How many dots are there?
items.e: The first ten-frame is full. That is 10. Then count on: 11, 12, 13, 14. There are 14 dots.
Each full row has 10. Count the rows by 10s: 10. Then count on by 1s: 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19. There are 19 buttons.

items.q: How many apples are there?
items.e: Each full row has 10. Count the rows by 10s: 10. Then count on by 1s: 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17. There are 17 apples.

items.q: How many dots are there?
items.e: The first ten-frame is full. That is 10. Then count on: 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16. There are 16 dots.
Each full row has 10. Count the rows by 10s: 10, 20. There are 20 stars.

items.q: Each rod has 10 cubes. How many cubes are there in all?
items.e: Each rod is 10 cubes. Count the rods by 10s: 10, 20, 30. Then count on the cubes: 31, 32, 33, 34. That is 34.

items.q: How many balls are there?
items.e: Each full row has 10. Count the rows by 10s: 10, 20. Then count on by 1s: 21, 22. There are 22 balls.

items.q: How many dots are there?
items.e: The first ten-frame is full. That is 10. Then count on: 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18. There are 18 dots.
Each full row has 10. Count the rows by 10s: 10, 20. Then count on by 1s: 21, 22, 23, 24. There are 24 buttons.

items.q: How many apples are there?
items.e: Each full row has 10. Count the rows by 10s: 10, 20. Then count on by 1s: 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26. There are 26 apples.

items.q: Each rod has 10 cubes. How many cubes are there in all?
items.e: Each rod is 10 cubes. Count the rods by 10s: 10, 20, 30, 40. Then count on the cubes: 41, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47. That is 47.
Each full row has 10. Count the rows by 10s: 10, 20. Then count on by 1s: 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28. There are 28 stars.

items.q: How many balls are there?
items.e: Each full row has 10. Count the rows by 10s: 10, 20, 30. There are 30 balls.

items.q: Each rod has 10 cubes. How many cubes are there in all?
items.e: Each rod is 10 cubes. Count the rods by 10s: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60. Then count on the cubes: 61, 62, 63. That is 63.
Each rod is 10 cubes. Count the rods by 10s: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80. That is 80.

items.q: Count on: 14, 15, 16, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Count on by 1s. After 16 comes 17. 71 has the digits the wrong way.

items.q: Count on: 23, 24, 25, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Count on by 1s. After 25 comes 26. 27 skips a number.

items.q: Count on: 28, ☐, 30. What number is missing?
items.e: The missing number comes after 28 and before 30. After 28 comes 29.

items.q: Count back: 86, 85, 84, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Counting back, each number is 1 less. 84 − 1 = 83.

items.q: Count on: 46, 47, 48, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 48 comes 49. Only the ones digit goes up by 1.

items.q: Each tick is 1 more. What number goes at the ?
items.e: Count on from 43: 44, 45, 46. Do not count the first tick.

items.q: What number comes just before 40?
items.e: Count back 1 from 40: 39. 41 comes just after 40.

items.q: Count on: 38, 39, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 39 comes 40. 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten. So 3 tens become 4 tens. Do not write 310.

items.q: Count back: 63, 62, 61, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Counting back, each number is 1 less. 61 − 1 = 60. 59 skips a number.

items.q: Each tick is 1 more. What number goes at the ?
items.e: Count back from 70: 69, 68, 67, 66. Or count on from 64: 65, 66.

items.q: Count on: 57, 58, 59, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 59 comes 60. 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten. Do not go back to 50, and do not write 510.

items.q: Count on: 68, 69, ☐, 71. What number is missing?
items.e: After 69 comes 70, then 71. 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten.

items.q: Count on: 77, 78, 79, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 79 comes 80. The 9 ones make a new ten with 1 more, so 7 tens become 8 tens.

items.q: What number comes just before 100?
items.e: Count back 1 from 100: 99. 101 comes just after 100.

items.q: Count on: 97, 98, 99, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 99 comes 100. 9 tens and 1 more ten make 10 tens. 10 tens is one hundred. Do not write 910.

items.q: Each tick is 1 more. What number goes at the ?
Count on: 107, 108, 109, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 109 comes 110. 100 and 9 ones, plus 1 more, is 100 and 1 ten. Do not write 1,010.

items.q: What number comes just before 110?
items.e: Count back 1 from 110: 109. Write 109, not 1,009.

items.q: Count on: 112, 113, 114, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Count on by 1s. After 114 comes 115.

items.q: Each tick is 1 more. What number goes at the ?
Which number is “twelve”?
items.e: Twelve is 1 ten and 2 ones. Write 12.

items.q: How do you say 14?
items.e: 14 is 1 ten and 4 ones. Say fourteen. Forty is 40.

items.q: Which number is “sixteen”?
items.e: Sixteen is 1 ten and 6 ones. The 1 comes first: 16. 61 is sixty-one.

items.q: Which number is “thirty”?
items.e: Thirty is 3 tens and 0 ones. Write 30. 13 is thirteen.

items.q: How do you say 50?
items.e: 50 is 5 tens and 0 ones. Say fifty. Fifteen is 15.

items.q: Which number is “nineteen”?
items.e: Nineteen is 1 ten and 9 ones. Write 19. 91 is ninety-one.

items.q: Which number is “forty-two”?
items.e: Forty-two is 4 tens and 2 ones. Write 42, not 402.

items.q: How do you say 61?
items.e: 61 is 6 tens and 1 one. Say sixty-one. Sixteen is 16.

items.q: Which number is “fifty-eight”?
items.e: Fifty-eight is 5 tens and 8 ones. Write 58, not 508.

items.q: Which number is “seventy-three”?
items.e: Seventy-three is 7 tens and 3 ones. Write 73.

items.q: Which number is “ninety-nine”?
items.e: Ninety-nine is 9 tens and 9 ones. Write 99, not 909.

items.q: Which number is “one hundred”?
items.e: One hundred is 10 tens. Write 100: a 1 and two zeros.

items.q: Which number is the same as 10 tens?
How do you say 103?
items.e: 103 is 100 and 3 more. Say one hundred three. One hundred thirty is 130.

items.q: Which number is “one hundred five”?
items.e: One hundred five is 100 and 5 more. Write 105. The 0 shows there are no tens. Do not write 1,005.

items.q: Which number is the same as 10 tens and 8 ones?
items.e: 10 tens is 100. 100 and 8 ones is 108. Write 108, not 1,008.

items.q: Which number is “one hundred ten”?
items.e: One hundred ten is 100 and 1 ten. Write 110. Do not write 100 and then 10.

items.q: How do you say 115?
items.e: 115 is 100 and 15 more. Say one hundred fifteen. One hundred fifty is 150.

items.q: Which number is “one hundred seventeen”?
items.e: One hundred seventeen is 100 and 17 more. Write 117, not 10,017.

items.q: Which number is “one hundred twenty”?
items.e: One hundred twenty is 100 and 2 tens. Write 120, not 10,020.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The number just left of the ? is 13. Count on 1. The ? is 14.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The number just left of the ? is 33. Count on 1. The ? is 34.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The row goes 57, 58, 59. After 59 comes 60. A row of the chart ends with a ten.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The number just above the ? is 46. Going down one row is 10 more. The ? is 56.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The number just above the ? is 81. Going down one row is 10 more. The ? is 91.

items.q: On a 120 chart, which number is just below 57?
items.e: Going down one row on the chart is 10 more. 57 + 10 = 67. 58 is just to the right.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The number just right of the ? is 19. Count back 1. The ? is 18.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The row goes 88, 89. After 89 comes 90. 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The number just above the ? is 67. Going down one row is 10 more. The ? is 77.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The row goes 97, 98, 99. After 99 comes 100.

items.q: A row on a 120 chart starts with 71. Which number ends that row?
On a 120 chart, which number is just above 104?
items.e: Going up one row on the chart is 10 less. 104 − 10 = 94.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The number just left of the ? is 104. Count on 1. The ? is 105. Write 105, not 1,005.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The row goes 107, 108, 109. After 109 comes 110. You can also look up: 100 + 10 = 110.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The number just right of the ? is 94. Count back 1. The ? is 93.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The number just right of the ? is 107. Count back 1. The ? is 106.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: The number just left of the ? is 114. Count on 1. The ? is 115.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: Count across the bottom row: 64, 65, 66, 67.

items.q: This is part of a 120 chart. What number goes in the box with the ?
items.e: Count on from 116: 117, 118. The blank box is 117.

items.q: On a 120 chart, which number starts the row after 110?
items.e: The row after 110 starts with the next number. After 110 comes 111.

items.q: Each tick is 1 more. What number goes at the ?
Isaac counted 97, 98, 99. What number comes next?
items.e: After 99 comes 100. 10 tens make one hundred.

items.q: Diego is reading a book. He is on page 108. What page comes next?
items.e: Count on 1 from 108. The next page is 109.

items.q: Which list counts on by 1s?
items.e: After 99 comes 100, then 101. The right list is 98, 99, 100, 101.

items.q: Parking spots are in order. A red car is in spot 59. A blue car is in the next spot. What is the blue car’s spot?
items.e: After 59 comes 60. 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten.

items.q: Each tick is 1 more. What number goes at the ?
Luis counts the steps as he walks up: 104, 105, 106. What step comes next?
items.e: Count on 1 from 106. The next step is 107.

items.q: Which number comes between 109 and 111?
Gabriel has 110 stickers. He gets 1 more sticker. How many stickers does he have now?
items.e: Count on 1 from 110. He has 111 stickers.

items.q: Ava counts back: 102, 101, 100. What does she say next?
items.e: Counting back, each number is 1 less. Just before 100 is 99.

items.q: Tickets at the fair go 100, 101, 102 … Harper gets the ticket after 104. What is her number?
items.e: Count on 1 from 104. The number is 105. Write 105, not 1,005.

items.q: Marcus has 10 strings of beads. Each string has 10 beads. He has 3 more beads. How many beads does he have?
Jayden is on page 99. He reads 2 more pages. What page is he on now?
items.e: Count on 2 from 99: 100, 101. Do not count page 99.

items.q: Sofia starts at 112 and counts on 5 more. Where does she stop?
items.e: Count 5 numbers after 112: 113, 114, 115, 116, 117. Do not count 112.

items.q: The class counts the days of school. Today is day 119. What day is tomorrow?
items.e: Count on 1 from 119. Tomorrow is day 120. 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten.

items.q: Mateo’s book has 120 pages. Which page comes just before the last page?
items.e: The last page is 120. Count back 1 from 120. The page before it is 119.

items.q: Gabriel counted 97, 98, 99. What number comes next?
items.e: After 99 comes 100. 10 tens make one hundred.
